parameters.description: Return the query's rows, or the manifest file it wrote. Manifests exist only for CREATE TABLE AS SELECT, UNLOAD and INSERT queries - asking for one on any other query fails.
parameters.name: query_result_type

options.label: Manifest file (CTAS, UNLOAD and INSERT queries only)

columns.description: The result set's columns, in order.

count.description: How many items this page returned.

has_more.description: True when Athena returned a paging token, meaning more items are available. Pass 'next_token' back as the action's Next token to fetch them.

header_row_removed.description: True when Athena's repeated column-name row was found at the top of the page and dropped.

next_token.description: The token for the next page, or null when this was the last page.

rows.description: The rows, each keyed by column name.

items.description: One result row as a mapping of column name to its value. Every value is a string (Athena returns all cells as text) or null for a NULL cell.

update_count.description: Rows written by a CREATE TABLE AS SELECT, INSERT INTO or UPDATE statement; null for a SELECT.

get_query_runtime_statistics.description: Read a query's timeline, input/output row counts and execution plan. Athena keeps the full statistics for about 30 days; an older query returns the timeline only.

output_stage.description: The query's execution plan as AWS sends it, with StageId, State, InputRows/OutputRows and a QueryStagePlan. Passed through rather than mapped because SubStages and the plan's Children nest to an arbitrary depth.

start_query_execution.description: Run a SQL statement in Athena and return its query execution id. The query runs asynchronously: follow this with Get query execution until the state is SUCCEEDED, then Get query results.
start_query_execution.name: start_query_execution

parameters.description: The SQL to run, for example 'SELECT * FROM sales.orders LIMIT 10'. Use ? placeholders and fill them in with Query parameters below.

examples.label: Create a database
examples.value: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS analytics

parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The data catalog the query runs against. Leave as AwsDataCatalog unless you query a federated source.
parameters.name: catalog_name

parameters.description: The default database for unqualified table names. Not needed if the query names its tables in full (database.table).
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.description: The workgroup to run in. It sets the results location, the engine version and any cost limit; leave empty to use 'primary'.
parameters.name: workgroup

parameters.description: S3 URI for the results, for example 's3://my-bucket/athena-results/'. Leave empty to use the workgroup's own location or its managed query results. A workgroup with 'Enforce settings' turned on ignores this.
parameters.name: output_location

parameters.description: Values for the ? placeholders in the query, in the order they appear. Athena quotes them for you, so this is the safe way to put a workflow value into SQL.
parameters.name: execution_parameters

parameters.description: Reuse a cached result from an equivalent query run in the last N minutes instead of scanning again (0-10080). Ignored on a workgroup that uses managed query results, which does not support reuse.
parameters.name: reuse_results_max_age_minutes

query_execution_id.description: The query execution id. Pass it to Get query execution, Get query results, Get query runtime statistics or Stop query.

query_execution_id.description: The query execution id. Pass it to Get query execution, Get query results, Get query runtime statistics or Stop query.

stopped.description: Always true - Athena returns an empty body, so this confirms it accepted the cancellation.

update_named_query.description: Replace a saved query's name, SQL and description. Athena requires all of them on every update and drops a description that is not resent, so read the query first and pass back what you are not changing. Its database and workgroup cannot be changed.
update_named_query.name: update_named_query

parameters.description: The saved query to replace.
parameters.name: named_query_id

parameters.description: The name to store. Required even when only the SQL changes - send the existing name to keep it.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: The SQL to store. Required even when only the name changes - send the existing SQL to keep it.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: The note to store. Leave empty to clear the existing one.
parameters.name: description

named_query_id.description: The saved query that was replaced.

updated.description: Always true - Athena returns an empty body, so this confirms it accepted the update.

description: Query data in Amazon S3 with Amazon Athena's serverless SQL: run a query and read its rows, track or cancel a running query, browse the data catalogs, databases and tables available to it, read workgroup settings, and manage saved queries.
